made_by: s2/s2loop/reason_video.py: the head-camera film with the trial's reason loop, colour-coded by phase

turns.say: look (first pictures)
measure the heights of the empty seat, the mounted knob and the loose knob from depth before planning (no motion)

turns.skill: depth maps (own pixel-to-world conversion, checked against point_at)
turns.say: map the empty seat, the mounted knob and the loose knob pixel by pixel from depth (no motion) to see the socket shape and sizes
fit the five-sided outlines of the socket, the mounted knob and the loose knob in world coordinates to learn the clearance and the yaw difference (no motion)
ask propose_grasps about the loose knob in a step of its own, before any motion, to see whether a policy clip can follow it
map the hob's heights and edges around the empty seat (no motion) to know where the hand has room
check with solve_ik that the arm reaches the placing poses over the socket and the palm-down poses for turning the seated knob (no motion)
scan with solve_ik which turn of the grasping hand lets the arm hold the knob over the socket and hover above it (no motion)
scan with solve_ik which hand turn a palm-down scripted grasp can take both at the knob's place and over the socket (no motion)
check with solve_ik where a pushing hand can stand around the socket, to choose the side on which the knob may end short (no motion)

the whole task before the first motion: scripted grasp of the loose knob, carry, set down short on the socket's near rim, look, fingertip push into the socket, scripted grasp and a quarter turn toward the flame mark, let go
scripted grasp of the loose knob from above with the fingers pointing away from the robot and an 8 cm lift, per plan step 1
read what the session believes is held and where the knob is really seen between the fingers, to aim the carry (no motion)
fit the knob's visible side face in the hand to learn how far it was pulled toward the wrist and whether it turned (no motion)
read the colours of the knob pixels seen in the hand (white pointer, black top) to learn which way the knob turned in the grip (no motion)

the knob turned about 38 degrees and tipped 19 degrees in the grip, so the carry must also turn the hand back by 38 degrees; ask the planner (no motion) whether one free move to a hover over the socket does both
lift the held knob 4.5 cm straight up with the hand kept level, so that its low edge clears the hob's collar during the carry

carry the knob to above the socket on a level arc that turns the hand 38 degrees counter-clockwise, which undoes the turn the knob took in the grip; it should end 17 mm short of the socket centre on the wrist's side
turns.error: grasp_slip (false: all 337 rows ran, the palm ended where planned and the knob was still between the fingers; the skill's look found no points in the hand because the knob's points join the hob in depth; the session dropped its held belief)

turns.say: the carry ended over the socket but the skill saw nothing in the hand; measure from depth whether the grey thing between the fingers is the knob in the hand or the knob lying on the seat (no motion)
depth shows the knob still between the fingers, 3 to 5 cm above the seat, so the slip report was false; ask estimate_in_hand to take the knob back into the session's belief (no motion)
turns.error: perception_failed: nothing is seen in the right hand (the points in the hand volume connect to something larger than a held object)

turns.say: the session lost its held belief over the hob (the knob's points join the hob in depth), so set_down is not available; ask the planner (no motion) whether a plain guarded line can lower the hand 2.5 cm before letting go
turns.error: planning_failed path_scene_collision: thumb tip 3.0 mm from the scene (the held knob seen as scene), may not come closer

turns.say: let go of the knob in place: lowering is refused without a held belief, and the knob hangs tilted the way it will rest with its low edge over the middle of the socket, so it should fall about 3 cm into the socket tipped; then clear the view
turns.error: planning_failed trajectory_invalid: release/open refused, thumb tip 3.0 mm from the scene (nothing moved)

turns.say: release_in_place was refused (the thumb is 3 mm from the knob it holds), so open the hand in a plain dwell where it stands; the knob should fall about 3 cm into the socket, tipped
move the open hand 15 cm to the right of the seat so that the head camera can see where and how the knob came to rest
the knob lies on the right seat but tipped far over; measure its heights and colours from depth to know how it lies (no motion)
fit the knob's faces from depth to learn its tilt and where its lower end sits in the socket (no motion)
the knob fell forward and leans on the socket's far rim with its foot on the socket floor; trace its upper ridge from depth to choose where a fingertip can press its near end down (no motion)
the knob fell forward and leans on the socket's far rim; press its near end down 3 cm with the fingertip, behind its foot, so that it rocks back into the socket
the knob now stands upright on the right seat like the mounted one; measure its top height, levelness, outline and pointer to see whether it is seated in the socket (no motion)
the knob stands on the seat but tipped 15 degrees and turned; fit its top face and pointer to learn how far it is turned away from the socket's five-sided shape (no motion)
locate the knob's near corner edge by height from depth, to aim a low fingertip push toward the socket's far side (no motion)

the knob stands in the socket tipped 20 degrees and about 4 mm short; push its near corner low with the fingertip, 7 mm toward the socket's far side and slightly downward, so that it slides in and drops flat
the knob now looks like the mounted one; measure its top height, levelness, outline and pointer to confirm it sits in the socket (no motion)

the knob is seated (top level at the mounted knob's height, centred on the socket); grip it from above with the scripted grasp, hand turned so that the fingers meet a flat face, without lifting, to turn it
turn the gripped knob 95 degrees counter-clockwise about the socket's axis, so that its pointer goes from straight ahead to the flame mark on the left
the quarter turn ran with all five fingertips loaded; open the hand in a plain dwell to let go of the knob
move the open hand up and to the right, away from the knob, so that the last look shows the seat and the hand ends clear of it
last look: the knob sits in its seat with the pointer at the flame mark and a blue flame ring shows on the right burner; put it in numbers before closing (no motion)
look (last pictures, then close)
